name: Tuban
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Indonesian first-party discovery was performed. The current official BHUMI viewer was inspected through its JavaScript/configuration: the default Bidang Tanah layer is Geoserver umum:Persil at /bhumigs/umum, with safe display fields penggunaan, tipehak, luas, nib, and akurasibidang. The parcel request route returned 401 anonymously; direct WMS/WFS capability paths returned 404. No geometry or stable native ID was verified.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: 200 official layer metadata; Bidang Tanah / Geoserver / umum:Persil
401 Unauthorized without token; no login or credential use
official local publication; BPN Tuban and 50,108 PBT across 23 villages evidenced

scopeLimits: No exact-point parcel hit or miss was treated as citywide evidence.
No map extent was used to infer absence.
A local BPN custodian and parcel-mapping procedure are evidenced, but public citywide polygon access and native-ID schema remain unverified.
No retained GeoJSON sample was created because no safe full native polygon and stable native identity were observed.
safeFieldAllowlist: public non-personal classification fields such as area/use/right-type
uncertainty: Official Tuban Regency evidence confirms local BPN cadastral activity, while the public BHUMI parcel layer is token-gated at the observed request route. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe fields were used. This research packet is not source integration/admission.
